notes: Toronto Police Service Public Safety Data Portal (Open Government Licence – Ontario). Dataset 'Neighbourhood Crime Rates Open Data': counts and rates per 100,000 by neighbourhood (158) and year since 2014, nine categories.

ArcGIS FeatureServer query of the layer as GeoJSON with the polygons (fields checked 2026-11-10: AREA_NAME, HOOD_ID, <CATEGORY>_<year>, <CATEGORY>_RATE_<year>, POPULATION_2025). The module adds resultOffset / resultRecordCount to page through the 158 features.
